_note: Which folders inside 'Volleyball DVW Files' get read, and how. folder = folder name, season = season label shown on the dashboard, type = practice / match (match files are also detected from their file names), scout = true for opponent scouting folders. rebuild.py reads this; the upload page (upload.py) adds new folders here. Scouting folders use the plain season label (e.g. "Spring 2026") so the scouting Season filter has one entry per season.
